title: Fourier expansion of a restricted mean
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{−1,1\\}^n$, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and fix signs $z_i\in\{−1,1\}$ for $i\notin J$. The mean of $f$ over the cube with these fixed signs, minus its mean over the full cube, equals the sum over all nonempty subsets $T\subseteq J^c$ of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $T$, multiplied by $\prod_{i\in T}z_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the sign cube
$J$ is a subset of the coordinates
$z$ assigns a sign to every coordinate outside $J$
